evidence.reason: Historical baseline observation, 2026-11-23, retained verbatim below; all present-tense absence statements in that observation refer only to subject baaf1e44b27a0006ab6316b75383fe88b3856e01: MEASURED at baaf1e44b27a0006ab6316b75383fe88b3856e01 (main, clean). scripts/write_verification_record.py takes --command, --exit-code and --summary as caller-supplied arguments and executes only git rev-parse to fill repo_commit when none is given; it runs none of the commands it records. The present writer's behaviour does not establish that every historical record was produced through it. All 39 VERIFY records are VERIFY v1 attributed testimony: each carries recorded_by and repo_commit, and all 154 commands[] entries across them carry only command, exit_code and summary. Some VERIFY records cite retained outputs and their SHA-256 digests, including VERIFY-20260821-0001 and VERIFY-20260915-0001; these references do not constitute a standard per-command observed-execution contract. No contract exists that binds, per command, machine-captured stdout and stderr, the execution environment, the verifier version or content hash, the test or rule version, the property the command is relied on to establish, and a verifier lineage status. SELF_MODEL_SCHEMA.md states this directly: VERIFY v1 records are attributed testimony about execution evidence and do not independently execute commands, and a future v2 writer should run commands, capture exit code and output, bind results to repo HEAD and write the record itself; no gap, plan or decision records that deficiency or schedules that writer. ABS-0004 Section 4.17 defines VerificationRun (verifier executor reference, verifier version, rule or test version, content-addressed inputs, execution environment, result, verifier_lineage_status) as defined and deferred. The tree contains no GitHub Actions workflow (there is no .github directory), and the sources examined contain no evidence that any check is configured to require verification bound to the exact candidate before merge. External CI and manual checks are not excluded by that absence. The self-model pre-commit hook checks staged self-model records in clones where scripts/hooks/install.sh has been run; core.hooksPath is unset in the packaging executor's clone at this commit. This gap records an absence of an observed-execution contract, not that any recorded result is false. Current reconciliation, 2026-11-25, subject a9800e156b01493b74d952d22dc1f852f291c66e: scripts/verify_v2.py, ai_lab/documentation/verification_v2.py, scripts/import_verification_v2.py, scripts/check_verification_outputs.py, VPROF-0001 and .github/workflows/verify-v2.yml are now present in main under PLAN-20261124-0001 and WARR-20261124-0001. The corrected local, CI-pass and deliberate-CI-failure receipts are retained as VERIFY-20261124-0004, VERIFY-20261124-0005 and VERIFY-20261124-0006 for their own recorded subjects; they are not promoted to evidence for the different main commit. The 2026-11-25 separated, non-independent technical review of the R9-R12 delta is retained in docs/reviews/verify_v2/REVIEW-CLAUDE-R9-R12-DELTA.md; its PASS grants no completion or lineage change. The workflow produces verification evidence; it does not itself enforce a required merge check or authorize any decision. Their root tree ids both equal f41b71481b2eb1e43de83fb9910337d8b88bf40f; this is tracked-content equivalence only, not an extension of either receipt's verification scope. name: Observed-execution verification exists; exact-candidate required-check enforcement and reliance conditions remain open
notes: Origin: the 2026-11-23 automation programme recorded in GAP-0005. Its step 2, evidence production, has no gap of its own; the reviewing executor confirmed against the repository that the deficiency is distinct from the catalog, ancestry and authorization gaps and recommended a separate record.

Ordering constraint stated by the reviewing executor and adopted: verification must exist for the exact candidate before the decision that relies on it. A record written after merge cannot supply acceptance evidence that did not exist before the merge.

Historical VERIFY v1 records keep their standing as attributed testimony. Producing observed-execution records must not convert any earlier record into observed execution, retroactively or by association.

Relations: GAP-0005's first slice, the C7 implementer and verifier pair, is to be carried on the records this gap produces; C10's verifier-lineage check depends on GAP-0008 and is not supplied by this gap, which can record the verifier's identity and content hash but cannot by itself establish independence. Observed execution narrows what a record can misstate about a run; it does not establish that the commands run test the property they are relied on for (P2), which remains a per-command declaration.
This gap authorizes nothing. Automation of plan admission, merge, or any delegated decision is outside it.

2026-11-25 reconciliation: PR #1 is merged at a9800e156b01493b74d952d22dc1f852f291c66e; the code, profile, schema and workflow absence described in the 2026-11-23 baseline is historical. This update records implementation progress only. GAP-0010 stays open, PLAN-20261124-0001 stays admitted pending PI completion, and GAP-0005 and GAP-0008 remain open without modification.

The corrected v2 contract records Git-status-reported paths at command boundaries, not byte-level tree equality; index-hidden edits and changes restored within a command are outside that observation. The environment allowlist is a transfer property, not a sandbox. Missing independent evidence does not increase origin or lineage standing.
recommended_first_slice: The previously recommended observed-execution writer, two-level receipt/canonical-record contract, content-addressed retention, integrity checker, importer, VPROF-0001 and pre-merge/post-merge CI workflow are implemented in main at a9800e156b01493b74d952d22dc1f852f291c66e under PLAN-20261124-0001 / WARR-20261124-0001. Do not schedule that implementation again. Review docs/reviews/verify_v2/completion/COMPLETION-PREPARATION.md with the local and deliberate-CI-failure evidence, final pre-merge VERIFY-20261125-0001 and separate post-merge VERIFY-20261125-0002, each bound to its own exact subject, together with the tracked-content-equivalence comparison and measured store growth; then record the PI completion decision. The PLAN is still admitted, and implementation merge or technical review is not that completion decision. Even completion of this first slice leaves GAP-0010 open for an explicitly governed operator arrangement requiring verification of the exact candidate before the decision that relies on it. Required checks, protected policy/CI paths and acceptance/admission machinery are separate later work; this record authorizes none of them. A post-merge receipt is not pre-merge evidence, tree equality is not verification-scope equality, and an import commit is not covered merely because it contains a receipt. C7 implementer/verifier qualification, tool or cross-kind equivalence and C10 lineage/ancestry remain the separate GAP-0005/GAP-0008 programme; no IndependenceAssessment is supplied here.
risk: A working writer, passing CI run or imported receipt could be mistaken for enforced pre-merge acceptance, authenticated CI origin, independent verification, or plan completion. The workflow is not a required merge check in the observed repository configuration; origin stays unverified and lineage stays self_authored_unreviewed. Each receipt covers only its subject. Environment capture is partial, declared properties remain P2-scoped declarations, and a clean command boundary means Git status reported no changes, not byte-level worktree equality. The C7/C10 evidence and authorization conditions required by the GAP-0005 programme must be established separately before reliance.
summary: At main a9800e156b01493b74d952d22dc1f852f291c66e (PR #1 merged on 2026-11-25), the first-slice implementation is present: the VERIFY v2 writer executes the stored profile, retains command outputs under content addresses, and emits receipts checked and imported through the v2 contract; VPROF-0001 and the GitHub Actions workflow are implemented. PLAN-20261124-0001 remains admitted pending the PI completion decision. GAP-0010 remains open because exact-candidate verification is not enforced as a required merge check. The 2026-11-25 GitHub observations report main protected=false and no repository rulesets. Receipts remain producer claims of observation, canonical origin_verification remains unverified, and verifier_lineage_status remains self_authored_unreviewed. VERIFY v1 records remain attributed testimony.
